strings.Авторское учебное изложение проверенных: Author's training summary of verified provisions, not a website facsimile
strings.Вернуть запрос гражданину с предложением: Return the request to the citizen and suggest they locate the missing files themselves.
strings.Включить доступные документы в ответ либ: Include the available documents in the response or identify where they have actually been officially published
strings.Всегда отказаться от ссылок и признать и: Always reject links and declare them unlawful.
strings.Вы получили отказ в доступе?: Have you received a refusal of access?
strings.Выберите допустимые действия и проверьте: Choose permitted actions and check their order. Independent actions may be carried out in different sequences.
strings.Главная страница или конкретный документ: The home page or a specific document?
strings.Главная страница любого официального сай: The home page of any official website is sufficient for any request.
strings.Да: любая главная страница подтверждает: Yes: any homepage confirms the presence of every document.
strings.Да: проект и принятое решение всегда рав: Yes: a draft and an adopted decision are always equivalent.
strings.Для уже опубликованной информации допуст: For information already published, a reply may identify the publication or the official website address where it appears. Verify that the requested information is actually on that official website. A direct link is more convenient, but is not itself the only format permitted by law.
strings.Если решение вопросов не относится к ком: If the issues lie outside the recipient's powers, the written appeal is forwarded to the competent body or official and the citizen is notified. An address does not establish authority.
strings.Жалобу на решения и действия работника М: A complaint about a service centre employee's decisions and actions goes to that centre's director. Do not confuse a centre employee with the body providing the service.
strings.Жалобу на решения и действия самого МФЦ: A complaint about the service centre's own decisions and actions goes to its founding authority or an official authorised by a regulatory legal act of the constituent entity.
strings.Жалобу нельзя направить на рассмотрение: A complaint must not be referred for consideration to the body or official whose decision, action or inaction is challenged.
strings.Закон вообще запрещает отвечать ссылкой: The law entirely prohibits responding with a link to published information.
strings.Закрыть работу: у сотрудника во внутренн: Close the task: the file opens for the employee on the internal network.
strings.Запрос информации рассматривается по спе: An information request follows special rules. If the information does not concern the recipient's activities, apply referral to the competent body with notification to the user.
strings.Запрос находится в работе, итоговый отве: The request is being processed; no final response has been sent. The training archive contains an adopted decision with two appendices. The simulated website section publishes only a draft. This is a request for documents, not for a new analytical report.
strings.Запрошенное размещено на официальном сай: The requested material is said to be on the official website. The draft response gives only the homepage; no one has checked whether the published material matches the request.
strings.Зафиксировать запрошенный состав докумен: Record the requested set of documents
strings.Какой файл вы нашли на сайте?: Which file did you find on the website?
strings.Любой официальный сайт освобождает орган: Any official website releases the body from checking the response's content.
strings.Можно ли считать запрошенные материалы у: Do the case materials establish that the requested documents are already published?
strings.Назвать общедоступные приложения секретн: Call public appendices secret without a legal basis
strings.Найденный материал не даёт запрошенного: The located material does not provide the requested complete adopted set. An official domain does not turn an incomplete publication into a complete response.
strings.Найденный проект не совпадает с запрошен: The located draft does not match the requested information.
strings.Найдите норму и проверьте её применимост: Find the provision and check applicability. A click count cannot replace information from external sources.
strings.Найдите правило ответа ссылкой на уже оп: Find the rule for responding with a reference to information already published.
strings.Наличие ссылки само по себе не устанавли: A link alone does not establish that the website contains the specific information requested.
strings.Направить запрос в Минтруд, поскольку та: Send the request to the Ministry of Labour because it publishes the text of 8-ФЗ.
strings.Начните с предмета обращения. Уточните,: Start with the appeal's subject. Clarify who made the disputed decision and which information is confirmed.
strings.Не заявлено обжалование уже принятого от: No appeal against an already-issued refusal has been made.
strings.Нет. Я уточняю запрос до ответа. Огранич: No. I am clarifying my request before the response. No one has cited a restriction on access.
strings.Нет: в модели публикации найден проект,: No: the publication model contains a draft, whereas the request seeks the adopted decision and appendices.
strings.Номер части статьи 19 закона 8-ФЗ: Number of the part of Article 19 of Law 8-FZ
strings.Обеспечить доступный заявителю способ по: Provide a way for the applicant to obtain appendix 2 and check that the response is complete.
The scope of the request is defined.
strings.Он помечен как проект. Приложений к прин: It is marked as a draft. The appendices to the adopted decision are not alongside it.
strings.Опубликован проект решения и анонс засед: A draft decision and meeting announcement are published. The adopted decision and its two appendices are absent from this publication model. This is a fictional snapshot, not an audit of a live website.
strings.Орган определяет подразделение или должн: The body designates the unit or officials responsible for information access. Publishing a law on a ministry website does not mean that ministry holds every requested local document.
strings.Ответ ссылкой полностью запрещён даже дл: Responding with a link is entirely prohibited, even for published documents.
strings.Ответ указанием места публикации допусти: A response identifying the publication location is permissible when the specific requested information is published there.
strings.Отделите реквизиты документа от его прим: Separate a document's particulars from its application. In the working source check, attach a specific passage and extract information from it.
strings.Перед отправкой в ответ добавили ссылки: Before sending, links to the adopted decision and appendix 1 were added. The appendix 2 link requires access to the internal office network.
strings.Подготовить ответ в подразделении органа: Prepare the response in the division of the body holding the requested documents.
strings.Подготовить ответ на каждый пункт запрос: Prepare a response to every part of the request
strings.Поиск принятых муниципальных документов: Begin searching for adopted municipal documents with Council of Deputies decisions and the budget section. A page labelled 'Draft' does not confirm that a decision was adopted.
strings.Помощник: «Часть 3 статьи 19 делает любу: Assistant: “Part 3 of Article 19 makes any link to an official homepage a sufficient response.”
strings.После принятия решения заявителю направл: After the decision, a reasoned reply must be sent to the applicant no later than the following day. This is a separate action, not a new full complaint consideration period.
strings.Правило исчисления в этом учебном деле:: Calculation rule for this training case: exclude the triggering day. Count all calendar days; if the end falls on a non-working day, move it to the next working day. This profile is specified by the scenario and does not automatically apply to every procedure.
strings.При нескольких вопросах, относящихся к р: Where several issues belong to different bodies, copies of the appeal are forwarded to the appropriate recipients. Keep the issues distinguishable.
strings.Принятое решение и оба приложения, не пр: The adopted decision and both appendices, not a draft or a comparative briefing.
strings.Принятое решение, приложение 1 и приложе: The body holds the adopted decision, appendix 1, and appendix 2. Their information is publicly accessible. The inventory and files were created exclusively for the training case.
strings.Проблема данного проекта ответа — отсутс: The problem with this draft response is that the requested documents are missing from the simulated publication, not the mere use of an official website address.
strings.Проверить доступность файлов и приложени: Check access to the files and appendices before sending
strings.Проверить фактическое размещение запроше: Check whether the requested documents are actually published; the law does not require a direct link exclusively, but a link must not substitute for missing information.
strings.Проверьте исходное событие и единицы счё: Check the triggering event and counting units. The reply deadline may differ from the deadline for a specific action.
strings.Проверьте основание ответа ссылкой на уж: Check the basis for responding with a link to information already published. Enter the part number of Article 19 and select what such a link must achieve.
strings.Прошу принятое решение о бюджете вместе: I request the adopted budget decision together with its appendices. The draft response gives me the homepage link. But there I found only a meeting announcement and an old draft.
strings.Рассчитайте крайний день ответа на зарег: Calculate the deadline for responding to the registered request under 8-ФЗ. No deferral was used; the request concerns this body's activities.
strings.Согласиться, не сопоставляя запрос и пуб: Agree without comparing the request with the publication.
strings.Сопоставить публикацию с архивной описью: Compare the publication with the archive inventory
strings.Сопоставьте новые сведения с предметом д: Compare the new information with the case's subject.
strings.Сослаться только на наличие официального: Rely solely on the existence of an official website without checking the requested materials
strings.Состояние учебного раздела сайта: State of the training website section
strings.Ссылка позволяет получить именно запроше: The link provides access to the specific published information requested; attachments and accessibility must be checked.
strings.Техническая доступность оценивается с по: Technical access is assessed from the user's perspective, not only from the employee's work computer.
strings.Только общий порядок жалоб по 59-ФЗ: Only the general complaints procedure under 59-ФЗ
strings.Удалить из запроса упоминание второго пр: Remove mention of the second appendix from the request.
strings.Учебная модель органа местного самоуправ: A training model of a local self-government body holding an adopted budget decision. You prepare a response under 8-ФЗ. The simulated publication and documents are fictional; no violation is attributed to a real municipal body.
strings.Часть 3 статьи 19 допускает указание мес: Part 3 of Article 19 allows the place of publication to be indicated. It is necessary to establish that the requested information is actually there.
strings.Что именно вы просите предоставить?: What exactly are you asking to be provided?
strings.Это официальный сайт муниципального окру: This is the official website of Nizhegorodsky Municipal District in Moscow. It is not the website of Nizhny Novgorod Oblast and is not identical to the district administration's website.
